description_for_human: Turn any website URL into a prompt for recreating its UI.
description_for_model: Website intelligence API for agents: 39 pay-per-call endpoints ($0.001-$0.05) that take a public URL and return JSON: page as markdown/text, metadata, contacts, social links, sitemap, robots.txt, broken links, SEO and AI-readiness audits, security headers, HTTPS, DNS, email security (SPF/DMARC), WHOIS/RDAP, Wayback history, tech stack, trackers, company info, brand kit, design tokens, screenshots, UI-recreation prompts and a crypto project website trust check. Pay in USDC on Base via x402 (402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Catalog: https://www.aypiai.online/.well-known/x402.json
